assets.notes: 11.8 MB self-contained GLB, ~213k triangles, 101 nodes, PBR with KHR clearcoat/transmission/iridescence/variants (Carmine Candy, Pearly Swirly, Torched Graphite). Generic concept car, no real-car brand. CAUTION: contains Khronos and 3D Commerce logos (license plate / steering emblem) under LicenseRef-LegalMark-Khronos, which grants no rights to use the marks beyond Khronos guidelines - hide/retexture the 'License Plate' node and 'InteriorSteeringEmblem' or keep them out of frame. Wheel nodes: WheelFrontL, WheelFrontR, WheelRearL, WheelRearR (each parent of Rim, BrakePad, BrakeDisc, tire mesh).
